description: This file defines the PsrCacheAdapter class which implements caching functionality by adapting the Psr\Cache\CacheItemPoolInterface for use with AWS SDK.

classes.name: PsrCacheAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class implementing CacheInterface to use a PSR cache pool within AWS SDK.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a PSR CacheItemPoolInterface instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key, returns null if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with an optional TTL (time to live).

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a cached item by key.
